title: Data and successive structures for the twisted ringed action site
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in the fixed universe [def-weil-size-convention], let $s:C\simeq C$ have continuous functor and inverse, let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf, and let $a:(s^{-1})^*R\simeq R$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], fixed pairs [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], and ringed topos morphisms [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Define the object copy, the underlying ring sheaf, module category, tensor, evaluation and pure tensors by their existing sheaf constructions [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Define $\sigma$ by precomposition with $s^{-1}$ and scalar restriction along $a^{-1}$. A Site structure specifies the copied-object category, degree-zero inclusion, bijections of arrows with $\coprod_{n\in\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Hom}(X,s^nY)$, power comparisons and the precise identity and composition laws. Its topology is the infimum generated by pushed-forward covering sieves; its coefficient ring sheaf restricts to $R$, with minus-one generator $a^{-1}$. A RestrictionPresentation adds the equivalence of $\sigma$, module and set restriction equivalences to fixed pairs, their generator equations and additivity, and the ringed geometric morphism with structural map and module adjunction pinned to restriction. ModulePresentation adds conservativity and creation of all small limits and colimits and finite exactness. OrbitPresentation adds the integer coproduct left adjoint, successor-shift and zeroth-summand equations, additivity and finite exactness. Presentation adds the normalized tensor and internal-Hom comparisons, their actions, unit, pure-tensor, symmetry, evaluation and naturality equations. These are the original data of lem-sf-twisted-action-ringed-site, with the restriction and exactness fields in separate successive structures; no data are chosen from an existence theorem.
